leadText:
The Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader (Japanese: ヘッドリーダー Head Leader) is the title used to address the top-ranked Gym Leader in the Orange Crew. Only Pokémon Trainers skilled enough to earn the four Orange League Gym Badges are allowed to challenge the Supreme Gym Leader in Pummelo Stadium.

In English, the title is only used in The Electric Tale of Pikachu . The English dub of refers to the position as the final Gym Leader in the Orange Crew in Hello, Pummelo! or an Orange League in Enter The Dragonite.
plainText:
The Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader (Japanese: ヘッドリーダー Head Leader) is the title used to address the top-ranked Gym Leader in the Orange Crew. Only Pokémon Trainers skilled enough to earn the four Orange League Gym Badges are allowed to challenge the Supreme Gym Leader in Pummelo Stadium.

In English, the title is only used in The Electric Tale of Pikachu . The English dub of refers to the position as the final Gym Leader in the Orange Crew in Hello, Pummelo! or an Orange League in Enter The Dragonite.

==Role==
The Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader serves as the final obstacle in the Orange League. Those who defeat the Supreme Gym Leader in a Full Battle earn the Winner's Trophy, become Orange League Honorable Trainers ( s in the dub), and are honored in the Palace of Victory.

At the time of 's journey in the Orange Islands, the Supreme Gym Leader is . Ash defeated Drake in Enter The Dragonite. No other Supreme Gym Leaders have been seen and it is unknown how one rises to this position.

In battle, the Supreme Gym Leader must obey specific rules that give an advantage to the challenger. For example, the Supreme Gym Leader is unable to switch mid-battle while the challenger is free to do so at any time.

Although the Supreme Gym Leader occupies a similar position to the Champions of the various Pokémon Leagues, they are not displaced upon defeat.
